name: kcc-design-workspace
description: KC&C design system: tokens, plain HTML/CSS kit, React package and playground.

scripts.tokens:check: node scripts/measure-font.ts --check > /dev/null && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/build-tokens.ts --check && node scripts/build-brand.ts --check > /dev/null && node scripts/verify-tailwind.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kcc/design && npm run typecheck -w playground
scripts.build: npm run build -w playground && node scripts/export-templates.ts
scripts.check: npm run tokens:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run check:pages && npm run check:pdf
